entry_points.text: Console and panic entry spans start claim, redirection and never-returning stop, verbosity raising, panic sync enabling, unblanking, timed flushing, unsafe atomic drain, legacy emission, forced install and oldest-readable query, tolerating no-op conditions with neutral results.

Audit entry spans freezable pump cycling snapshot, flush and sleep, short-lived reply threads serializing on control lock, central dispatcher validating status, feature and user requests, plus start-format-end logging and filter predicates tolerating uninitialized or excluded cases.

exports.text: Console sync brackets spinning ownership with waiter wake and handover report, and offers sleeping acquire waiting out foreign panic, nonblocking acquire failing then, plus release flushing when direct legacy output is active.

Printk services raise verbosity, enable panic sync, unblank usable consoles, timed-flush one or all consoles from a reservation point to budget expiry, dispatch dumps by threshold, and query oldest readable sequence with constant fallback.

Nbcon offers legacy emission with handover, clamped install and unsafe panic drain; panic offers never-returning stop, async redirection, single-winner start, once-only crash stop and taint query; watchdog offers notrace touches refreshing deadline, one poking workqueue.

Audit record core allocates buffer with fragment queue and stamp, tolerates absent buffers with on-demand growth, stamps and labels on start after backlog admission, and on completion rate-admits each fragment to global queue else accounts loss and wakes delivery.

Audit annotation adds session and subject context with aux records; delivery places unsent records on hold or retry queues within limits else emits via printk and accounts loss, retry for transient failure and hold when consumer is gone.

Filtering evaluates ordered rules under read protection requiring all predicates, covering identity, category, login, executable mark and access attributes; terminal match suppresses or stops, with equality, ordered and bit-test operators plus identity-aware uid and gid variants.

Audit configuration funnels rate, depth, wait budget, enablement and failure disposition through shared helper logging when active, denying updates while locked, latching ever-enabled, and installing daemon identity with counted process and network references plus deferred reclamation.

Audit formatting provides task, path and terminal helpers plus untrusted encodings branching to hex or quoted form with safe growth; reply helpers build netlink replies with sequence, completion-preferring type and payload and drive async list transmission then release.

hazards.text: After handover references are invalid and callers abandon; during panic spinners get no service, acquisition defers to foreign owner and nonmaskable avoids counting-lock; narrow suffixes need clamping; ordinary producers may sleep boundedly while daemon or control holders bypass to avoid deadlock.

Unicast uses 5 attempts for hold and retry and single attempt for main per iteration; transmit must not hold read protection without network reference; multicast must copy; growth failures record loss; length uses checked ops falling back to marker.

invariants.text: Reservation size adds header to payload then rounds to block alignment; generation shifts position by configured width and wrap compares start versus inclusive end so exact fits do not wrap; bounded line tally starts at one and adds per newline until exhaustion.

Single flush skips alternate-path consoles, advances each usable at most one record, tracks greatest sequence and handover, aborting on foreign panic; outer repeats on advancement and rechecks successor; legacy emission skips empty formats and selects direct versus protected writes by build constant, one build idle.

Rewind moves every console to oldest readable using nonblocking install for one family and direct assignment for the other, clamping to readable positions; nonblocking legacy emission binds default-priority context for one record, treating handover or takeover as loss of responsibility, with neutral header fallbacks.

Interrupt-guarded printk regions either combine masking with explicit safe bracketing or reduce to masking alone by build; spinlock permission across legacy writes is either empty or a balanced attempt and release pair around the device call.

Forced relocation needs enabled config, distinct online destination, no concurrent panic and single-winner claim, then raises verbosity and dispatches transfer whose failure releases claim; peer shutdown optionally backtraces under temporary permission omitting local cpu, then picks standard versus once-only crash stop.

Admission throttles to configured count per tick window, zero disabling; loss warns at most once per window unless panic or unthrottled and always runs failure action; stamps combine coarse clock with atomic serial, reusing valid syscall stamp and promoting to recording priority on first use, else fresh pair.

Reset clears only on matching or absent handle, moving retries to hold; unicast snapshots under protection then sends after release, resetting on refusal; drain remembers tail; multicast copies best-effort; admission separates families by privilege; features use enable plus sticky locks with validate-then-apply.

locks.text: Counting acquire marks locked and records scheduling permissibility, allowing sleep for sleeping acquire and forbidding for nonblocking, with dependency annotations; release clears mark; spinning guards holder and waiter, wake passing ownership onward, panic skipping tracking.

Daemon pointer mutates under interrupt-safe spinlock with ordered store and deferred reclamation, observed under read protection with copies before blocking sends; reply threads briefly acquire then release control lock to wait for parent operation; queue drain assumes background exclusion.

state_machines.text: Flush ends on quiescence, handover, foreign panic or no advance, else forces another pass and reacquires on post-release work; relocation claims, dispatches, then stops on success or releases on failure; unblank probes, acquires conditionally, iterates guarded, releases and timed-flushes outside fault.

Pump snapshots connection, flushes hold then retry with fixed budget then main with multicast, aborting and resetting on negative flush before sleeping for work; registration enforces single healthy owner; dispatch branches to status updates, feature query or update, and filtered user logging with terminal push.

structs.text: Printk state spans ring width governing generation, block identifier governing alignment, console with sequence and loss plus callbacks, flush selector with atomic, offload and direct modes, message view with buffers, length, loss and sequence, and write context binding console with priority and backlog.

Reply context carries buffer, network reference and port with tolerant cleanup, encoding sequence, completion-preferring type, multipart flag and copied payload; three queues separate fresh main, retry for plausible daemon, and hold for absent destination fed from retry on reset and main when undeliverable.
